# Requirement — Add a Tag to a Note

The notes app already lets a person create, read and delete notes.

Add tags:

- A note can have zero or more tags.
- A tag is a short text label.
- A person can add a tag to a note and remove a tag from a note.
- A person can list notes filtered by one tag.
- Tags are scoped to the note's owner, exactly like notes are today.
